events.title: Capsule Marble Hotfix
events.summary: Hey Mancalero candidates! There was quite the error allowing for Capsule Marble upgrades to persist between runs, making the demo far easier than intended for those of you who decided to invest in capsule upgrades. This has been patched in the most recent Hotfix, apologies for the error. Please enjoy your runs and stay tuned for the full game! Grace and peace, ArchiusDev

events.title: MacOS Launch Options
events.summary: Apologies for the confusion, now the launch options on MacOS will clearly display the correct version based on your architecture- make sure to use Apple Silicon if you're using the M-series chips or Intel if you have those. Using the wrong one will negatively affect frame rate and your overall experience. Grace and peace, ArchiusDev
